sandbox.lede: A sandbox is a box of its own on your wisp Grid for one piece of work: the agent can install, run and break anything there, never on this computer. Start one with /sandbox in New task; a delegate, a crew member's jobs or a goal's judges can run in one too. Each goes with what it was made for.
sandbox.signin.hint: Sandboxes run on your own subscription. Claude signs in once for all of them; Codex and the others sign in inside a sandbox, on its task's first turn.
sandbox.claude.off: Not signed in: /sandbox asks for this first
sandbox.env.hint: In every sandbox's environment, sealed on the grid. Values never come back here.
sandbox.launching: Making a sandbox for it: about half a minute
